name: Name
error: Operation failed. See the local log.
notify_offline: Notify when a device goes offline
privacy_hint: No telemetry. All history stays on this PC.
overview_hint: Your local network, observed over time.
health_hint: Score uses sampled gateway availability and latency. It is not a security assessment.
map_hint: Logical subnet view, not physical topology. Dashed links show membership; only known addresses are displayed.
traffic_hint: Upload and download belong to the selected interface of this PC. Per-device bandwidth is unavailable.
availability_hint: Availability is the percentage of successful recorded ICMP probes. Sleep and firewalls can appear as offline. It is not continuous uptime.
access_hint: Read-only local connections. Process information may be limited without administrator rights.
diagnostics_hint: Checks run only on your PC and local gateway. DNS checks query localhost on a private configured resolver; external resolvers are skipped.
report_hint: Snapshots preserve observed device metadata. JSON includes observations, events and notes; CSV exports devices.
consent: Enable discovery only on your own or authorized local network. One ICMP probe per address; maximum 254 hosts. Discovery is disabled until you allow it.
port_hint: This button performs a limited TCP connection check on 12 common ports in the selected private subnet. No service fingerprinting. At most one check every 15 seconds.
subnet_hint: Only private IPv4 subnets /24 or smaller are supported. Select a smaller authorized subnet.
demo_hint: Generate random data for every tab. Real network history stays separate.
